ResearchProjectDef.label: cyberlink
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a bionic implant that provides access to cyberspace. implants allow installation of other implants and enable hackers to interact with cyber entities more efficiently. Although it offers many benefits, it can also trigger specialized security-system responses that are normally ineffective against disconnected hackers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: exec data case
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an implant that links exec data to the cyberlink with nanoconnectors, allowing the usage and training of execs.
Execs are trained during hacking.
